profile.headline: Software Engineer at Benchling
profile.summary: I am motivated by impact and mission. If you want to pitch me, tell me how your product will save the world.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Architect/Engineering Lead for "Benchling for Lab Automation", a suite of integrations with liquid handlers and analytical instruments in pharmaceutical and biotech labs.

positions.title: Summer Undergraduate Research Fellow
positions.description:
-Designed and implemented a neuroscience experiment on human subjects
-Integrated 3 software systems (MATLAB, fMRI scanner, thermal stimulator)
-Analyzed experimental data

positions.title: Laboratory Research Intern
positions.description: Discovered time and location of expression of several genes which are expressed during sea urchin embryonic development via in situ hybridization

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Synthesized photodegradable hydrogels using Grubbs Catalyst for Ring-Opening Metathesis Polymerization

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
ASU CampGame Teaching Assistant
Assisted high school students in the design and development of a game built with the Unreal Development Kit
